title: Leave their portion and keep your own heart
summary: Let your own heart, work, and remembrance come back into view. Do not let the day outrun this: let this stay with you: wholeness begins when the Name is kept in the heart.
takeaway: Let contentment quiet the need to compare.
lifeApplication: When envy rises, step away from the screen and return the mind to one truthful task already in your hands today.

source.shortMeaning: Wholeness returns when the heart leaves another person's portion.
source.lifeApplication: Before naming someone else's advantage, put your hand on your chest and name the work, prayer, or duty actually given to you.
